none: PAS NLM-9FC1BA: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274), Cunetio no. 2604. Obverse description: Radiate head bearded right. Obverse inscription: [--]TETRICVS[--]. Reverse description: Pax standing left holding sprig aloft and with vertical sceptre or standard right. Reverse inscription: PA[X AVG]. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.29gms, die axis: 12
